name: code-server
description: Installs the code-server standalone release and starts the server from postStart.

auth.description: The authentication type, none or password. The default none gives anything that can reach the listen address the remote user's access.

host.description: The address in --bind-addr when socket is empty. The default keeps the server on loopback.

port.description: The port in --bind-addr when socket is empty.

socket.description: An absolute Unix socket path. When set, the socket is used instead of host and port.

socketMode.description: The file mode of the Unix socket, as octal digits. Used only when socket is set.

workspace.description: The positional workspace path. An empty value uses the hook's current directory.

passwordFile.description: A file read at postStart into PASSWORD. Trailing newlines are removed.

hashedPasswordFile.description: A file read at postStart into HASHED_PASSWORD. Takes precedence over passwordFile.

githubAuthTokenFile.description: A file read at postStart into GITHUB_TOKEN.

args.description: One code-server argument per element, appended after the option-derived arguments.
